steps.description: Pre-filter genes to those with at least 10 counts in at least 3 samples (the smallest group size). Build a DESeqDataSet from the raw count matrix and metadata with explicit factor levels (condition reference level set explicitly, not left to alphabetical order; time as an ordered/nominal factor t0..t3 with t0 as reference). Separately, extract Wald-test simple effects of condition at each time point (t0, t1, t2, t3) using the appropriate contrasts, and shrink each with apeglm (or ashr where the contrast is not a single model coefficient) for reporting/ranking. State explicitly that with only 3 replicates per cell, the interaction test has low power; a gene absent from the interaction gene list is not evidence of no true difference.

plan.title: 2x4 time-course interaction DE + enrichment
plan.analytical_narrative: The design is 2 conditions x 4 time points (t0-t3), n=3 raw salmon counts per cell (12000 genes x 24 samples per metadata; count file lists 25 columns, one presumably a gene-ID/label column consistent with 24 samples + gene symbol). The research question — genes with a treatment-specific change over time beyond the shared time trend — is exactly the DESeq2 likelihood-ratio-test (LRT) time-course design: fit the full model ~condition+time+condition:time against the reduced model ~condition+time. Genes significant in this LRT have a time trajectory that differs by condition, independent of any trend shared by both conditions. Because the smallest cell holds only 3 replicates, the interaction test has limited power (per grounded rule R-0063/R-0017); this is stated explicitly in the report rather than compensated by loosening thresholds. After identifying the interaction-significant genes, their time profiles (log2FC vs t0, per condition) are clustered into a small number of representative trajectory shapes and visualized, and Wald simple effects at each time point are reported alongside the LRT to show which time points drive the interaction, per rule R-0092. Enrichment is done as over-representation analysis (ORA) with an explicit tested-gene universe against the MSigDB Hallmark, Reactome, and GO-BP gene sets staged in the reference store — the enrichment_agent's knowledge-service check confirmed this is the correct method when the enrichment input is the discrete interaction-significant gene list (gene_list mode), rather than a preranked GSEA (which the check flagged as not permitted for this differential-expression situation/gene_list combination). All steps are grounded in the Inflexa knowledge service's bulk-rna-seq differential-expression procedure, with genuine reference and package checks performed against this environment: DESeq2 1.52.0, apeglm 1.34.0, fgsea 1.38.0/clusterProfiler 4.20.0, org.Hs.eg.db 3.23.1 are all installed; MSigDB Hallmark/Reactome/GO-BP human gene sets and NCBI human gene identifiers are staged in the reference store.
